formula: Subject + will ('ll) + base verb · Negative: won't + base verb
when_to_use: Use 'will' for on-the-spot decisions, predictions, and offers; 'won't' for the negative.
when_to_use_ar: نستخدم will للقرارات اللحظية والتوقعات والعروض؛ و won't للنفي.
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: Learners add 'to' after will ('I will to help') or use 'will' for pre-made plans where 'going to' is more natural.

common_errors.explanation: No 'to' after will — use the base verb.

practice_fill_blank.sentence: That bag is heavy — I ___ help you.

quick_rule: will/'ll + base verb (decisions, predictions, offers). Negative = won't.
quick_rule_ar: will/'ll + الفعل المجرد (قرارات، توقعات، عروض). والنفي won't.
mnemonic: Decide NOW / predict / offer → WILL + verb.
connect_to_speaking: Make predictions and offers: 'I think the team will win. That's heavy — I'll carry it for you.'
